goal: teste et mesure toutes tes pistes

protocol.isolation: Candidates are materialized from the baseline in tmp/performance-campaign. Retained local/imported compiler passes are integrated separately; experimental runtime strategies remain isolated.
protocol.timingBuild: minified production, fresh browser contexts, seeded interleaving
protocol.completion: Every item requires tests, measurements or a measured feasibility ceiling, provenance and a documented decision. A count/profile alone is not a timing result.

items.title: Index de liste paresseux
items.decision: retained only for proven lean lists

items.title: Bindings prouvés résolus sans effet éphémère
items.decision: restricted prototype, not enabled
items.coverage: Only exact framework constant scalar readers and direct input expressions. Object member reads are intentionally excluded; primitive fixture improves, realistic page does not.

items.title: Fusion de bindings d'une source scalaire prouvée
items.decision: non-equivalent ceiling: reject the current prototype; input-reader replacement changes callback granularity and ordinary cases gain no established benefit
items.coverage: Consecutive exact reads of renderer-owned numeric indexes or normalized primitive constants. Unknown-reader side effects, DOM observation order, Proxy probes, primitive rebinds, identity and destruction are tested. A reader-replacement counterexample rejects general activation. Ordinary rows, a favorable repeated-index fixture, the realistic page and no-plugin controls are measured.

items.title: Dépendances d'inputs et rebinds partiels
items.decision: restricted prototype, not enabled: ordinary row update gain not established and retained heap increases
items.coverage: Only proven lean list factories own the input objects. Static dependency analysis, stable primitive index readers, getter refusal, Proxy fallback, DOM observation order and destruction are tested. Standard rows, indexed/nested controls, realistic page and a sixteen-index-cell synthetic control are measured.

items.title: Listes de composants constants locaux
items.decision: retained
items.coverage: Local const components after definite initialization; conservative fallback through hoisted declarations. Default and lean compiler modes retain their existing contracts.

items.title: Listes de composants importés et graphe du bundler
items.decision: retained behind imports: true, default false
items.coverage: Direct named imports of compiled const exports in a proven acyclic loaded application graph. Import aliases, lexical scope, cycle refusal, opt-in, SSR exclusion and real Vite watch rebuilds are tested. Imported 5000-row fixtures improve with lean; the realistic page does not.

items.title: Éviter le contexte de résolution quand il n'y a pas de wrapper
items.decision: not retained: timing gain not confirmed

items.title: Records de requêtes et résolveurs partagés
items.decision: rejected: bound shared resolvers give negligible memory savings and regress focused resolution

items.title: Scans de marquage versionnés sur objets possédés par Craft
items.decision: two cache prototypes rejected by contracts; owned/versioned design remains pending

items.title: Couverture des styles, attrs et helpers de propriétés
items.decision: retain attrs/h coverage with tracked eager reads, ordered captures and ABI-2 fallback; style coverage remains pending
items.coverage: Closed nested attrs and literal h helpers measured and integrated with eager-source tracking, ordered captures, safe old-runtime fallback, shadow/collision refusals and null-overload contracts. 232 final timed navigations plus two superseded screens (80 and 88), ordinary controls in three modes, 80 integrated output comparisons, 118 compiler and 609 component tests. Style binding coverage remains pending. Owned-input source tracking is additionally protected by a generic fallback, two red/green cases, 120 current compiler tests and 104 follow-up navigations, including 40 targeted indexed confirmations.

items.title: Couverture des éléments de formulaire
Plans à plusieurs racines
items.decision: restricted measured prototype, not integrated: connected-DOM observation differs and ordinary-case overhead needs removal
items.coverage: Nonempty fixed element/text ranges, nested arrays, scopes, replay identities, owners, range reorders, rebinds, events/holes, cloning and cleanup failures are tested. Favorable standard/lean/list-ablation/clone cohorts, ordinary standard/lean controls, realistic page and no-plugin controls are measured. A connected-DOM counterexample is reproduced against both the prototype and existing compiler.

items.title: forNode et ifNode dans les plans plutôt qu'en trous
Fabrique DOM commune parent/enfants avec propriétaires conservés
Insertions groupées des sous-arbres prouvés inertes
Matérialisation paresseuse de l'injecteur, propriétaire logique conservé
Isoler le support du compilateur du bundle sans plugin
items.decision: restricted prototype, not enabled: bundle reduction proved; latency is noisy and activation introduces an ESM cycle
items.coverage: Both compiled component renderer classes and their plan lookup/create helpers disappear without plans and remain with the plugin. Some list bookkeeping remains. Ordinary, lean and standard browser contracts, realistic page, late activation, invalidation, TypeScript and library suites are checked. Bundle reduction is measured; no mounting improvement is established.

items.title: Réduction du template de repli dans un build spécialisé
Hydratation compilée et récupération des mismatches
Parse/bind/emit : intérêt mesuré d'OXC
items.decision: not retained for the current JavaScript AST pipeline
items.coverage: Thirteen real modules, fully materialized ASTs, seventeen syntax/output contracts, seven fresh processes, compiler stage timings and a measured zero-parser counterfactual. OXC AST incompatibility is tested; no backend migration is claimed.

items.title: content-visibility et contain-intrinsic-size
items.decision: restricted; no automatic activation
items.coverage: Fixed-height blocks retain all components and save layout work. A missing offscreen button in the CDP AX tree is reproduced with complete accessibility enabled; focus activates it. Keyboard, window.find, print override and dimensions are tested.

items.title: table-layout: fixed avec colonnes explicites
items.decision: restricted application layout policy
items.coverage: Known width and explicit columns reduce layout time on this table. A long-label control proves truncation versus growth; no compiler rewrite is enabled.

items.title: Fenêtre de lignes visible, composants Craft conservés
items.decision: restricted benchmark prototype; no public component added
items.coverage: Window plus overscan and pinned focus, with Craft row buttons and global indexes. Offscreen DOM/AX/search/print scope differs; native Tab across a pinned gap skips unmounted rows.

items.title: scheduleFor : premier affichage, tâches longues et temps complet
items.decision: measured trade-off; initial-only policy remains a benchmark prototype
items.coverage: Default scheduling, provided FrameForScheduler, and initial-only wrapping of the same FrameForScheduler are interleaved. First rows, full completion, updates, reorder, late append, cancellation and source changes are tested. Total CPU and later long tasks remain visible.

items.title: Événements/trous, lowering, lectures directes de services, clone/create
items.decision: retain proven lean mechanisms and corrected service reads; create default, clone opt-in
items.coverage: Seven controlled variants, realistic page and 5000-row fixtures, focused service-state updates, no-compiler declaration control, recovered historical raw data, and red/green owner/reader contracts.

items.title: Nettoyage et raccourci de contexte injecteur
items.decision: cleanup retained; injector-context shortcut rejected

items.title: Rendu impératif retiré : observations conservées, sans réintroduction
items.decision: removed as requested; measured observations retained
